items.excerpt: Elena Vicario argues scholarly-publishing policies must formally embrace AI in peer review to cope with research misconduct at scale: 'if AI is part of the problem, it also has to be part of the answer.' A concrete call to rewire the editorial/peer-review workflow around AI-supported reviewer tools.

items.excerpt: A new ANU report by Millicent Weber surveying 503 Australian and 500 German audiobook listeners finds 17.4% have already tried AI narration or text-to-speech, quantifying how fast synthetic narration is entering everyday listening.
